notes.title: v1.0.1 Patch Update
notes.notes:
This patch update is to fix a small bug.


v1.0.1 Patch Notes

-A crash caused by a missing background image has been resolved.


Other News

We're currently in the process of setting up the studio's Discord server. Later this week we'll be sharing an invitation link for anyone who wants to hang out with the devs and get the inside scoop on future projects by Source Error Productions. ːsteamhappyː

In the meantime, we hope everyone enjoys their time with Awakening of Legend!
